partition_origin: Complete books I-II discovery and III-IV held, selected from primary metadata before word/rule counts
boundary_claim: Supplied annotated source-sentence units, not historical paragraphs or inferred clauses
metadata_exclusion: ittb-forma-sN concordances excluded by work identity before text/token materialization
key_generation: Unchanged source-independent GDT834 typed-value shuffles and full 38-ID opaque alias shuffle; same packet shared between STRICT/RELAXED
normalization: Frozen GDT832 normalization and exact annotation joins; all ordered representable words retained; any unrepresentable alphabetic word excludes its whole source-sentence unit
annotation_policy: MWT/unknown analyses remain unknown; held lemma novelty compares singleton joins against union of all discovery analyses
reference: Byte-identical native Monarchia reference, candidates, IDs and empty family factors inherited via GDT834; no u/v normalization or deduplication
freshness: New mixed ciphertext control within GDT832-836, but ITTB train was already a GDT832 reference; its orthography differs from native Monarchia
unused_rule_policy: Rules absent in discovery and held are unidentifiable/unscored; every held-active literal requires discovery support
stop_policy: Any gate failure stops keys, ciphertext and historical fitting without source/split/deck/threshold edits
